note: Long-lived API tokens for non-browser clients — in particular an AI/MCP client such as Claude Code or Claude Desktop. A token carries a role and is shown once at creation; only its hash is stored. The read-only MCP tool surface (Settings enable the MCP server with YAGRA_ENABLE_MCP) authenticates with these tokens.
